card.name: Dose numbers and Pretomanid regimen commas
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a dose amount such as 400 mg, 50 mg or 150 mg. Also the comma after "Pretomanid Tablets" in the Pretomanid, bedaquiline, and linezolid regimen.

modes.label: Comma in drug regimen
modes.description: The comma after Pretomanid Tablets in the three-drug combination regimen.
